author: famian09
body:
After Reading 70 replies, and after a long time I will finally edit the post to make more paragraphs. And some ppl requested a TL:DR?

Hi I famian09, a long term player at avicus. I am not making this post to praise Avicus as right now the server is at its worse than its ever been. With the new update to 1.8 only servers, the entire game broke. And this isn't a recent issue. Once Avicus started make the few 1.8 only servers and added their "revolutionizing" nocheat. The gameplay has been crap. Thats why I used to only play on the 1.7 servers. Now that Avicus updated to 1.8 my friends and I feel that playing on the server has become a burden and a place of rage rather than fun.

 So I just told all this stuff saying that Avicus is bad, but never explained the real problem causing these feelings. 
 Well lets just say upgrading to 1.8 in general was horrible, the pvp mechanics are really bad, hitboxes are random (mostly dependent on ping) and damages are unbalanced. And don't get me started on the nocheat. Like I swear it is worse than MCGAMER's by a mile. And by that comparison you know it must be really bad. And it is.

 First off we have the character flying above us. We know about this because of that one kid who thinks that character is a real person hacking. That only stops people using a very old hack which is force field (I think or something like Kill Aura forgot the name). But what it does, is that when the hacker is in a chest the hack causes the player to hit the character in the air then banning them. Great right bans the hacker, but one problem. NO HACK CLIENT USES THIS HACK ANYMORE. That anticheat is so popular that all the good hack clients wouldn't have that hack. But fine all that does is distracts the player doesn't affect gamplay too much. But what about us walking, flying in spectator, and placing blocks. Like come on and I can't sprint fly without being rubberbanded. Then when I run while place blocks, at least 1/2 of my blocks aren't placed. When I PvP or just move around, i am being rubberbanded. Then there is the bow.

 Oh my the bow. When trying to aim and walk a bit, it automatically teleports me back and switches to my slot next to bow. Isn't that fun. While trying to bow a bunch of players away from me or do a bow fight. I can't fire more than one shot without being nocheated. The thing I don't get is that this server has developers, so what are they doing? Are developing a better no cheat or doing nothing but banning skilled players for "hacking". If this current dev team can't make a decent nocheat that will actually ban hackers and not affect our gameplay then Avicus needs some new developers. 

Note: A simple solution to half of these issues is remove the current nocheat. It was done before and gameplay was a lot better.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
The developers cannot find the source of the blocklag, and development has been slow on fixing these because A, you cannot push directly to the server, and B, you cannot take a local version of the Avicus plugins to see if you have fixed something. It takes, according to a developer, approximately 6 hours for a manual code push to make it live. Luckily, progress is being made VERY efficiently to localize the plugins without a database dependency, and ALM had been a pretty good help too as an addition. The administration and development team have high ambitions to make 2016 the year for Avicus, and we're doing what we absolutely can to improve infastructure. Things also may be better with the recent dev meetings and plans, as well as pavilion returning.

We, and I, don't want to see the network to die. Keep in mind not everything is done overnight, steps must be taken.

Our progress is well and alive. The inefficiency is being all fixed up! If you have questions, I'll try to get a dev to help, just reply. Keep in mind we have priorities, and posting on GitHub helps!

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
To be fair, he IS one of the senior players (around 2 years of playing on this server) and he has a right to express his opinion.

To put it bluntly, he's right on several of the points he has made. The character above our heads can be annoying, but that pales in comparison to the names that float around us. It's like being followed by an invisible stalker xD.

However, it's not all negative. 1.8 has helped to make the server more interactive, and overall the system is more efficient. 

Many of the points you have made (e.g. block lag) have been here for as long as anyone (more-or-less) can remember. It's not something that can be easily fixed, and it takes time and effort that, frankly, the staff evidently don't have.

Stop highlighting the negatives as if the transition has been completely flawed. There are positives and negatives, which is the same for everything.

To everyone else who has commented: Don't just ridicule what he has said. He's right on some points, and if we start ignoring the opinion of a player (a senior player at that), then there's no point to having the forums.

Thanks for reading. =)

Although there is none of this on the Throwback server. The hit detection is certainly a lot worse, but you get used to it. LabY mod also makes you feel a bit better in 1.8 by bringing back the old blockhitting animation, the hit-before-you-draw-back-a-bow animation and the hit-before-you-eat animation. It also has the old fishing rod animation and the sneaking animation.

The only thing I'm really mad at to Avicus is the Throwback server going offline every 2 days....

replies.author: Subscriptor
replies.body: I will speak for myself. I'm not fed up with these posts, I do agree with all the points on this post. It's frustrating to see that none of the issues that were mentioned in this post are not fixed yet, even though Kylo is busy and our development team is small. However we still got a new dev which is super experienced and I am sure he will help to sort some issues. I don't know anything in coding, but from what I can guess what makes it hard to code is the huge changes between the versions. The changes between versions 1.3-1.7 were really minor (adding blocks, some other features) compared to the major 1.8 update which changed the PvP aspect, the main thing of this server. For example, creative or building servers didn't get much affected by the 1.8 change, however PvP servers needed to put a lot more effort to make their gameplay compatible and lagfree with the 1.8 version. While our developers are fixing the issues already, 1.9 is coming soon and it will be even more changes to PvP than 1.8. In my opinion that is the main reason why the devs couldn't fix it yet. Again, speaking for myself.

replies.body: Just to be clear, I joined the server 2 years ago but I haven't been playing too much because I don't find the gamemode as interesting or as fun as HCF but this thread has caught my attention as I was spending time reading random threads. There is a few points I'd disagreed with. First of all, the reason why Famian09 said that most staff are being biased on who is getting promoted or who is getting chosen to be staff is because most donors tends to be more active and they're usually a senior player. Secondly, A Mod that gets butt hurt over these threads shouldn't be staff to begin with since they're promoted to solve these problems and not to complain about them. Thirdly, the use of posting of these threads are sometimes helpful to the staff and try to make them work better then they use to. Last of all, if the server are constantly getting negative threads about them, then they should try a bit harder or at least make something new that distract the players attention. I know the developers are working their best to solve the issue but as a player we'd always want to have fun and not rage over every single game that we play and I'm sure that Famian09's intention was for the good of the server and so is my respond that I'm posting right now.
